Real places → city-generation references

North-up geography on a consistent metric grid. These are measured samples, not complete cities or an AI-trained model. Building coverage and district data depend on source availability.

Roads: sand · buildings: blue-grey · street-enclosed blocks: slate · tagged land use: green · water: blue · available boundary ways: coral. Each view includes a 100 m scale. Road widths are symbolic.
